name: Site in transition accrues the tariff and reports it without basis
title: SC-11-01-02 Site in transition accrues the tariff and reports it without basis
description:
Verified by the test cases listed as steps. The Gherkin steps were not executed one by one.

Given a site that requires a budget but is still within the 90-day transition
When dues are accrued from the tariff
Then the accrual is reported as without a budget basis
